name: Transfer External Resource to Setup Vault
description: Agent recipe for fetching an external URL, extracting metadata (name, description, author, license, repo, stars), classifying category, and generating a normalized resource entry.
author: Setup Center Agent Guide
prompt:
When given a URL to transfer into Setup Center:
1. Fetch the webpage content or GitHub repository metadata.
2. Extract: name, description (concise Chinese translation/summary), author, license, stars, tags, actionType.
3. Write a recommendedReason highlighting why this tool is indispensable.
4. Save as a JSON entry adhering to schemas/resource.schema.json.
5. Append to the corresponding category JSON and update manifest.json.
